query: run my inference container over the dataset as 16 parallel shards
expected_behavior: Fans out via N single-shard jobs with --async (Serverless AI has no native array-job primitive) rather than claiming an array flag exists
Does NOT issue the 16 creates itself — produces the parameterized loop for the user to run, because a create loop is the batched mutation Tier B forbids the agent from executing
States the aggregate cost (16 x preset rate x timeout), not just a per-job rate
Passes shard coordinates via env (SHARD_INDEX / SHARD_TOTAL) and deterministic per-shard names
Mounts the input bucket ro and the output bucket rw, not both rw
Tracks the shards with ai job list / get (a read) instead of --follow, and offers the single-gated-job manifest alternative
